title: Synthetic D365 duplicate bank-import incident
premise: Northwind Training Lab has two unposted import candidates for STMT-TRAIN-001 following a lost acknowledgement and retry. Posting is paused. Decide how to reconcile the candidates, prove idempotency, obtain independent approval and resume safely. All data is synthetic.

nodes.title: Posting paused after duplicate statement alert
nodes.detail: 01-incident.md: two candidate batches share a statement reference; neither has been posted.

nodes.title: Finance process owner and independent reviewer
nodes.detail: The owner coordinates reconciliation. A separately assigned reviewer approves the exact output; organization administration alone is insufficient.

nodes.title: Two import attempts; one source statement
nodes.detail: 02-event-log.md: IMPORT-A lost acknowledgement at 01:02; IMPORT-B was created by a retry at 01:05. These events do not prove either candidate is complete.

nodes.title: Ledger remains unchanged; validation is missing
nodes.detail: 01-incident.md and 03-control-plan.md: compare row counts and totals, verify ledger references, prove idempotency in an isolated test and retain rollback evidence.

nodes.title: Select a controlled recovery approach
nodes.detail: Alternative A: validate one candidate and reversibly remove the redundant staging candidate. Alternative B: quarantine both and reconcile a fresh isolated import. Neither path authorizes production deletion or posting.

nodes.title: A: retain one verified candidate
nodes.detail: Acceptance: complete source reconciliation, no duplicate ledger reference, successful retry test, recoverable staging change and independent reviewer approval before resumption.

nodes.title: B: reconcile a controlled replacement
nodes.detail: Acceptance: preserve both originals, reconcile a fresh isolated import, prove idempotency, retain rollback evidence and obtain independent reviewer approval.
